commands.title: Moji Pro: Toggle Code Block Highlighting
Moji Pro: Toggle React Component Outlines

mojiPro.enabled.description: Enable or disable emoji keyword decorations.

mojiPro.customEmojiOverrides.description: Per-keyword emoji overrides. Keys use the internal category-prefixed format (e.g. 'await', 'py:for', 'tag:div'). Managed by the Moji Pro settings panel — use the panel rather than editing this directly.

mojiPro.disabledDecorations.description: Disabled decorations by category. Managed by the Moji Pro settings panel.

enumDescriptions: Hide keyword text and show only the emoji.
Dim keyword text and show the emoji before it.
mojiPro.displayMode.description: How emojis are rendered relative to keywords.

mojiPro.overlayOpacity.description: Opacity of keyword text in overlay mode (0 = invisible, 1 = fully visible).

mojiPro.emojiSize.description: Size of emoji decorations. 'small' is 75% of the default size.

mojiPro.codeBlocks.enabled.description: Enable code block highlighting — applies a subtle background tint to each detected code block.

mojiPro.codeBlocks.functionColor.description: Background tint for function, method, and class blocks. Accepts any valid CSS color string (e.g. rgba, hex, named colors).

mojiPro.codeBlocks.loopColor.description: Background tint for loop blocks (for, while, do). Accepts any valid CSS color string.

mojiPro.codeBlocks.controlColor.description: Background tint for control flow blocks (if, else, switch, try, catch, finally). Accepts any valid CSS color string.

mojiPro.codeBlocks.objectColor.description: Background tint for object literal blocks and other unlabeled blocks. Accepts any valid CSS color string.

mojiPro.htmlTags.description: Master toggle: show emojis for HTML tag names.

mojiPro.htmlVoidElements.description: Master toggle: show emojis for HTML void elements.

mojiPro.htmlAttributes.description: Master toggle: show emojis for HTML attribute names.

mojiPro.javascriptKeywords.description: Master toggle: show emojis for JavaScript keywords.
